title: FrameRecord
description: The Framer's non-premise output at a ledger version: goal ladder, metric interrogation, problem type, dissolution verdict, acceptance criteria, B0. Not in SYSTEM.md section 4's record list, which names only PremiseRecords for the Frame phase; added because the phase table's Frame row produces these and they need a single-writer home (D47). Single writer: Framer (Frame). Append-only; a correction is a new record referencing this one.

id.description: Record id: a lower-case type prefix, a hyphen, at least three digits. Unique within a run.

ledger_version.description: The ledger version this record was written against. A CandidateRecord citing a version other than the frozen one is rejected by the Scribe.

references.description: Ids of the records this one is derived from or responds to. Never edit those records; reference them.

goal_ladder.description: One rung in quick mode, three in deep: the stated goal, the goal behind it, the goal behind that.

metric_interrogation.description: What the stated metric measures, what it misses, and what a wrong answer would score.

problem_type.description: The relational form's name, for library indexing and technique selection.

dissolution_verdict.description: dissolved: the problem does not exist as stated once premises are classified. reframed: it exists but not as stated; the goal ladder says how.

dissolution_reason.description: Why, in one paragraph. 'n/a' when the verdict is stands.

acceptance_criteria.description: Fixed before generation. Copied from the ProblemRecord if supplied, proposed otherwise, and not revised after candidates are seen.

b0_candidate_id.description: The CandidateRecord holding B0, the deductive baseline, written by the Framer with technique b0.

premise_count.description: Premises at this version. Cap 40; the Framer merges above it.

stable.description: True when no premise changed class since the previous version.
